title: Cove.

services.name: Cheerful Vacation Home Rentals
services.desc: Start with Cove on Bridge Street, then wander the south end. These are the shops, kitchens, and studios we love most, and the people who make them. On the corner of Bridge Street, between the gulf and the bay. Stop in for a slow browse, a chat with Kelly, and a closer look at the work. Cove art now lives at the north end too. Our work climbs the stairs and fills a full gallery wall inside Upstairs, a shared creative space we're building with Body & Soul Spa and Salty Buddha. Original pieces you won't find on Bridge Street. a gallery & boutique to find local art & inspired gifts for the ocean-minded
